text.tspan: WaveNet / gated residual and skip iteration | Operators & tensor flow
Loop i1 / phase dilation2 / gated Conv2 / residual + skip states / read bottom to top
First dimension encodes folded dilation phases in this implementation; selectedN1, not an arbitrary batch claim.
Filter/gate/residual/skip ModuleList index1 are four independent weight families.
Two top outputs are loop-state boundaries; the model output head is excluded.
Reviewed static source + selected profile. Repeated groups are templates; shapes are not runtime observations.
E### = source span; dashed = side / shape dependencies; fork/join roles are typed in IR; no implicit sum.
Repeated colors encode operation roles. Shared weights and independent instances are recorded in semantic_ir.json.
